description: Limited commemorative exploration dungeon. Clear stages to obtain exclusive Sinon avatar outfits, celebration stamps, and rewards!

description: To celebrate Sinon's birthday, receive 100 Arcana Gems every day for 10 days by logging in for a total of up to 1,000 Arcana Gems!

name: 100th Floor Release - Ruby Palace
description: The monumental 100F is finally here! Face the ultimate floor boss, explore new labyrinth maps, and craft the legendary Sovereign Weapon series.

name: 8.5th Anniversary Celebration Campaign
description: Special Anniversary festivities featuring free daily 11-Orders, double EXP campaigns, and an anniversary medal exchange shop!

name: Ring Production Campaign
description: Features halved production costs and increased rewards for specific boss battles to help players strengthen their equipment.

name: Summer Fishing Tournament
description: A competitive event where players aim for high scores. Participants are encouraged to aim for over 10,000 points to rank highly. Rewards include exchanging fish for Arcana Gems and Fishing Medals.

name: Klein's Test of Courage
description: A horror-themed story event where players can obtain a "Ghost Mask" and a 4-star Yuuki reward. The event also provides a total of 1,000 Arcana Gems for participation.

name: Guild Battle Challenge
description: Allows guilds to customize boss fight rules. Achieving an SSS Rank can reward up to 5,000 Arcana Gems.

name: Summer Watermelon/Maguro Operation
description: A returning event featuring Egil and fish-themed weapon avatars. Players can earn up to 500 Arcana Gems.

name: Leafa's Limit Break Dojo
description: An enhancement-focused dungeon where players can gather large quantities of Memoria for skill record limit breaking. It also features a "True Sword Limit Break Memoria Dojo" for high-level players (recommended total power 250,000).

name: Fatal Battle
description: The highest difficulty challenge in SAOIF. It is designed as a peak test of player skill, with adjustments made to ensure it remains a formidable, high-end experience.

name: 100% Egil Order
description: A daily free 11-pull banner where the lineup consists exclusively of Egil skill records.

name: 8.5th Anniversary Avatar Campaign
description: To celebrate the global 8.5-year milestone, players will receive a daily free 11-pull avatar order for 10 days, totaling up to 110 free pulls.
